contract: act(observation, valid_actions, history, llm) -> str: the next text command. observation is the game text after the last command, valid_actions the parser-accepted commands for the current state, history the list of (action, observation, reward) so far, llm the cached budgeted OpenRouter client (llm(prompt, system=None, max_tokens=None) -> str). Score: final game score / maximum score after STEPS commands, averaged over RUNS seeded plays. Higher is better.
notes: TextWorld treasure-hunter game generated by scripts/prepare_game_data.py (tw-make, fixed seed); BALROG's other TextWorld games (coin collector, cooking) are generated too and can be selected in the parameters.

Recreated agent protocol: the game engine (Jericho z-machine games from the Jericho suite, or TextWorld games generated locally) is the paper's environment, but the step budget, prompt format and the absence of the papers' test-time-learning or BALROG wrappers are local choices; scores are comparable within the suite only. Model calls go through the budgeted client (default budget 0.25 USD per evaluation).
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
